title: Spotify Is Bringing Video Podcasts to Netflix in Early 2026! 🎙️
body: Spotify Is Bringing Video Podcasts to Netflix in Early 2026! 🎙️
Spotify and Netflix have announced a new partnership that will bring Spotify's video podcasts to the Netflix screen at the start of 2026.
A video podcast is a talk show you can listen to and watch at the same time — like a TV show, but on the internet.

It will begin with selected shows from Spotify Studios and The Ringer network, including the Bill Simmons podcast and The Rewatchables, with more shows joining later. The first release under this partnership had actually already launched on 11 November.
The move supports Spotify's push toward video and earning money for creators, with interactive features such as polls and Q&As.
Do you watch podcasts, or do you just listen to them? 📺
